properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 30 at 1:01PM CDT until September 30 at 5:00PM CDT by NWS Goodland KS
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Western Sheridan County in northwestern Kansas...
Thomas County in northwestern Kansas...
Western Gove County in west central Kansas...
Logan County in west central Kansas...

* WHEN...Until 500 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1259 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to rain
showers. Minor flooding is may begin shortly in the advisory
area. Between 0.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 2 inches are expected over the
area.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Colby, Oakley, Grinnell, Levant, Rexford, Monument, Gem, Menlo,
Russell Springs, Mingo, Angelus, Halford, The Monument Rocks and
Seguin.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 PM CDT THIS AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 30 at 12:51PM CDT by NWS Dodge City KS
properties.description:
At 1250 PM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Bloom, moving north at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph. Although not an imminent
threat, the environment may also support brief, weak
tornadoes.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

This strong thunderstorm will be near...
Bloom around 1255 PM CDT.

Other locations in the path of this storm include Ford.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

NWSheadline: A STRONG THUNDERSTORM WILL IMPACT SOUTHEASTERN FORD AND NORTH CENTRAL CLARK COUNTIES THROUGH 130 PM CDT

properties.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued September 30 at 1:02PM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
ESFLOT

Waves of rain, and possibly a few thunderstorms, will continue
through Thursday night. High moisture content in the atmosphere will
lead to periods of torrential downpours and the threat for 1 to 3
inches of rainfall on a widespread basis through Thursday night.

Repeated rounds of rain over saturated soils may lead to flooding of
low-lying and poor drainage areas as well as rises on area rivers,
including along the Rock, Fox, DuPage, Des Plaines, and Illinois
Rivers.

This outlook means that elevated water levels and potential impacts
are possible, but not yet certain. Persons should closely monitor
forecasts including the possibility of flood watches, warnings, and
advisories.

Additional statements or outlooks may be issued late tonight.

NWSheadline: Areas of flooding and significant rises in river levels possible through late week

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 1 at 3:06AM ChST until October 4 at 4:00AM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 30 to 35 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Guam and Rota.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Friday to 4 AM ChST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tropical Storm 26W will impact Saipan and
Tinian, and the far northern Marianas late this week and into the
weekend. South of Tropical Storm 26W, a monsoon surge will develop
across the Marianas. Winds could approach near-gale force in the
higher terrain with gale force gusts. Windy conditions may continue
beyond Saturday night and this product may need to be extended.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution when driving on roads with no
center barriers, as well as when passing high profile vehicles.

Secure loose objects outdoors, as well as canopies. These winds may
move light objects.

NWSheadline: WIND ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 4 AM FRIDAY TO 4 AM CHST SUNDAY
